exposure: Access to information sources about childbirth
outcome: Childbirth self-efficacy (Outcome Expectancy and Self-efficacy Expectancy)
cohort: 358 eligible pregnant women with a gestational age of 37 weeks and over in Guilan (North Iranian province) from November 2018 to July 2019
finding: Birth preference, education level, and perceived social support were significant predictors of childbirth self-efficacy.
